content.text: Just listened to the new track by Hichkas. Absolute fire! 🔥 The production quality and lyrics are on another level. What do you all think about it?
My top 5 Persian rappers: 1. Hichkas 2. Bahram 3. Shayea 4. Erfan 5. Yas. Who would be in your top 5? Let's discuss!
Just posted my review of the latest album. Check it out on my profile! I think it's one of the most significant releases this year.
Working on some new beats inspired by traditional Persian music mixed with modern trap elements. Will share some previews soon!
What's everyone's favorite track from Ho3ein's latest album? The third track has some of the most complex rhyme schemes I've heard in Persian rap!
Discovered this amazing underground artist yesterday. Very unique flow and thought-provoking lyrics. Here's a link to their latest track.
Just got tickets to the upcoming hip-hop festival! Can't wait to see all these amazing artists perform live. Who else is going?
I've been analyzing the social commentary in Bahram's lyrics. It's fascinating how he addresses societal issues through his music. Very thought-provoking.
